speaker: Howard
text: We had to take her. It's almost bathing suit weather. Oh! I surrender. Don't shoot me. Went that way. Oh, Leslie, thank God.

speaker: Leslie
text: Howard, I'm on your team. Where's the rest of your squad?

speaker: Howard
text: Ugh, they left me here to die. What about yours?

speaker: Leslie
text: Dead. All of them. Don't be. It was friendly fire. They just wouldn't listen.

speaker: Howard
text: Well, we're surrounded, so I guess there's nothing for us to do but wait to be captured or killed.

speaker: Leslie
text: Hmm, that's the worst part, the waiting.

speaker: Howard
text: All the while, knowing that there's a paint pellet out there with your name on it.

speaker: Leslie
text: Yeah, the big wet ball of death. Kinda makes you feel more alive, doesn't it?

speaker: Leslie
text: I say we make every moment count.

speaker: Howard
text: I agree. Now, exactly what do we do then?
